title: 524. Circular Array Loop

examples.explanation: Starting at index 0, the jumps visit 0 -> 2 -> 3 -> 0, a loop of length 3 where every jump is forward.
From index 0 the jump goes backward to index 1, but from index 1 the jump goes forward to index 0, so the directions mix and no valid loop exists.
Every walk either changes direction or collapses onto a single index, so there is no loop of length greater than 1.

hints: From each start index, walk forward following the jumps while every step keeps the starting direction.
A walk that revisits one of its own indices (with a real move, not a self-loop) proves a valid cycle exists.
